এই আওয়ামী সন্ত্রাসীটা বোমা বানাতে গিয়ে নিজের বোমাতেই মারা গেছে। অবশ্যই খুবই জঘন্য ও করুণ মৃত্যু। আনন্দিত হওয়ার মতো। কিন্তু এই বাচ্চাটার জন্য একটু খারাপ লাগছে। ও সারাজীবন জানবে, ওর বাবা একজন সন্ত্রাসী ছিল, যে নিজের বোমাতেই মারা গেছে। এই খারাপ লাগাটা সবসময়ই হয়। এই সন্ত্রাসীটা যে এমপির সহকারী ছিল, সে এখন দেশের বাইরে ফুর্তি করছেন। কমপক্ষে হাজার কোটি টাকা লুটপাট করে এখন বিলাসী জীবনযাপন করছেন। আর যারা পালাতে পারেনি, তাদেরকে গণতন্ত্রের পক্ষের শক্তি দেশের ভেতরে সুষ্ঠুভাবে বেঁচে থাকার এবং জীবন পরিচালনার সুযোগ দিয়েছিল। তাদের ওপর যে পরিমাণ নির্যাতন হওয়ার কথা ছিল, তার সামান্যতমও হয়নি। কিন্তু ওরা এটাকে দুর্বলতা মনে করে ফেলল। এখন ওরা বাংলাদেশের মানুষের প্রাণহানি ঘটাতে চায়। বোমা হামলা করতে চায়। এমন একজনের নির্দেশে এসব করতে চায়, যিনি মাত্র বিশ দিনে ১,৪০০ মানুষ হত্যার জন্য দায়ী। যাদের আস্ফালনের কারণে এসব হচ্ছে, তারা হাজার কোটি টাকা লুটপাট করে বিদেশে সুখের জীবন কাটাচ্ছেন। আমি খুবই চাই, হাসিনাকে ঝুলাতে। হাসিনার সঙ্গে তাঁর যেসব মন্ত্রী সতেরো বছর ধরে ভোট ডাকাতি করে সারাদেশে লুটপাট করেছেন, তাদেরও মৃত্যুদন্ডের রায় কার্যকর করতে চাই। আমি জানি, হাসিনা আসবেন না। আর এই সরকারের হাসিনাকে ঝুলানোর সদিচ্ছা আছে কি না, সেটাও জানি না। হাসিনা একটা পিওর সা *ইকো। তিনি তাঁর পরিবারের লোকজন বাদে নিজের নেতাকর্মীদের কথাও চিন্তা করেননি। এ জন্যই তার পরিবারের যাঁরা দেশে ছিলেন, তাঁদের ২৭-২৮ জুলাই দেশের বাইরে পাঠিয়ে দিয়েছেন। কিন্তু তাঁর নেতাকর্মীদের ৪ তারিখেও জনরোষের সামনে ঠেলে দিয়েছেন। এখন তার আত্মীয়স্বজন জয় কিংবা পুতুল তো দূরের কথা, শেখ তন্ময়, শেখ তাপস, শেখ নাঈম কাউকেই দেশে পাঠাচ্ছেন না। তিনি অপেক্ষায় আছেন, তাঁর নিজের যেসব নেতাকর্মী আরামে আছেন, তাঁদের উসকে দিয়ে আবার জনরোষের সামনে ফেলার জন্য। এক জীবনে এই সাঈ কোটাকে ঝুলানো যদি দেখতে পেতাম, তাহলে আর কিছু চাইতাম না। শুধু হাসিনা নন, হাজার হাজার কোটি টাকা পাচারকারী শেখ রেহানা, ববি সিদ্দিকী, শেখ সেলিম, শেখ তাপসদের ঝুলে যাওয়া দেখতে পারলেও মনকে সান্ত্বনা দিতাম। আওয়ামী লীগের জন্য সবচেয়ে সুন্দরতম বার্তাটি দেন অ্যাডভোকেট কামাল উদ্দিন। তিনি দেশেই আছেন, পলাতক নন। কিন্তু এরা নিজেদের বোমায় নিজেরাই মারা যায়। আফসোস! মোল্লা ফারুক ভাই। বাংলাদেশে এমন একটা পরিবেশ গড়ে তোলার স্বপ্ন নিয়ে রাজনীতি করতে চাই, যেখানে এই বাচ্চাগুলোও স্বগৌরবে পরিবার নিয়ে বাঁচতে পারে। এতটুকুই স্বপ্ন। নতুন রাজনীতি তৈরির স্বপ্ন।

အိုင်စီ ဂျေ စီရင်ချက် ကုလသမဂ္ဂ လုံခြုံရေးကောင်စီ တံခါးပိတ်ဆွေးနွေး ** *** မြန်မာနိုင်ငံသည် ရိုဟင်ဂျာများအပေါ် လူမျိုးတုံးသတ်ဖြတ်မှု ကျူးလွန်ခဲ့ကြောင်း အပြည်ပြည်ဆိုင်ရာ တရားရုံး (ICJ) က ဆုံးဖြတ်ခဲ့ပြီး ခြောက်ရက်အကြာတွင် ဗြိတိန်၏ တောင်းဆို မှု ကြောင့် ယခုကဲ့သို့ ယနေ့ တံခါးပိတ် ‌ဆွေးနွေးပွဲ ဖြစ် မြောက်လာခဲ့ခြင်းပင် ဖြစ်သည်။ ကုလသမဂ္ဂက အဆိုပါအစည်းအဝေးကို ဗုဒ္ဓဟူးနေ့ နယူးယောက်စံတော်ချိန် နံနက် ၁၀ နာရီ (မြန်မာစံတော်ချိန် ည ၉ နာရီခွဲ) တွင် ကျင်းပရန် စီစဉ်ထားပါသည်။ ကောင်စီအဖွဲ့ဝင်များသည် မြောက်ကိုရီးယားအပေါ် ပိတ်ဆို့အရေးယူမှုများအကြောင်းကို ဦးစွာဆွေးနွေးကြမည်ဖြစ်ပြီး ထို့နောက် ဗြိတိန်နိုင်ငံ၏ တောင်းဆိုချက်အရ “အခြားကိစ္စရပ်များ" အစီအစဉ်အောက်တွင် မြန်မာ့အရေးကို ဆက်လက်ဆွေးနွေးကြမည်ဖြစ်သည်။ ယနေ့ ဆွေးနွေးမှုသည် ပဏာမ ညှိနှိုင်းမှုသာဖြစ်ပြီး မြန်မာနိုင်ငံ၏ ပိုမိုကျယ်ပြန့်သော အခြေအနေများနှင့်ပတ်သက်သည့်အဓိက သီးခြားအစည်းအဝေးကို ဒီဇင်ဘာလ ၇ ရက်နေ့ တွင် ကျင်းပရန် စီစဉ်ထားသည်။ ထိုအစည်းအဝေး ကျင်းပပေးရန် ဗြိတိန်နိုင်ငံ၏ တောင်းဆိုချက်ကို ပြင်သစ်နိုင်ငံက ထောက်ခံထားသည်။ ကုလသမဂ္ဂ၏ မြန်မာနိုင်ငံဆိုင်ရာ အထူးကိုယ်စားလှယ် ဂျူလီ ဘစ်ရှော့ နှင့် အာဆီယံ ၏ မြန်မာနိုင်ငံဆိုင်ရာ အထူးကိုယ်စားလှယ်ဖြစ်သူ ဖိလစ်ပိုင်နိုင်ငံခြားရေးဝန်ကြီး ထရီဆာ လာဇာရို တို့အား လုံခြုံရေးကောင်စီသို့ အခြေအနေများ ရှင်းလင်းတင်ပြပေးရန် ဗြိတိန်နိုင်ငံက တောင်းဆိုထားပါသည်။ ICJ ၏ ဆုံးဖြတ်ချက်များကို လိုက်နာရန်မှာ နိုင်ငံတကာ ဥပဒေအရ မဖြစ်မနေ လုပ်ဆောင်ရမည့် တာဝန်ဝတ္တရားတရပ်ဖြစ်ကြောင်း ပြောကြားလျက် မြန်မာနိုင်ငံအနေဖြင့် အဆိုပါစီရင်ချက်ကို “နှောင့်နှေးကြန့်ကြာမှုမရှိဘဲ” အပြည့်အဝ အကောင်အထည်ဖော်ရန် ဥရောပသမဂ္ဂ (EU) က တိုက်တွန်းလိုက်ပါသည်။ အငြင်းပွားမှုများကို ငြိမ်းချမ်းစွာ ဖြေရှင်းရေးနှင့် တရားဥပဒေစိုးမိုးရေးကို Russia has increased its oil exports to their highest level since the start of the full-scale war, but the value of those shipments has fallen to an 11-week low, Bloomberg reported. Russia is exporting an average of 3.65 million barrels of oil per day this year. Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries are one reason for the increase, as Moscow is being forced to sell abroad oil it can no longer process domestically. According to Bloomberg estimates, Ukraine has struck 17 Russian oil refineries since the beginning of November. The combined design capacity of the first 15 facilities alone accounts for more than half of Russia’s total refining capacity. The surge in Russian exports is adding to the global oil oversupply and putting further downward pressure on prices. Brent crude has already fallen nearly 25% from its late-October peak. Meanwhile, the gross value of Russia’s seaborne oil exports fell to $1.94 billion last week, its lowest level in 11 weeks.

People over machines: Russia turns to manual labor amid technological decline and equipment shortages Russia’s economy is facing a shortage of technology rather than workers, according to a new study by the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation, cited by the Russian newspaper Nezavisimaya Gazeta. The study says that years of insufficient investment in modernization have left businesses struggling with a lack of machinery and automation. As a result, companies are being forced to rely on millions of workers to perform manual tasks, including to fulfill state defense contracts. According to the research, investment in machinery and equipment as a share of total capital accumulation in Russia fell from 43.9% in 2005 to 14.7% in 2024. “What is currently happening in the Russian labor market can be described as the price of ‘technological lag.’ This is a consequence not so much of a demographic slump as of a profound investment and fiscal crisis. We are searching for millions of workers only because we failed to replace them with machines and robots over the past decade,” the researchers wrote.

On October 1, 1960, the Nigerian people cast off the shackles of British colonial rule . The Soviet Union was among the first countries to establish diplomatic relations with the newly independent African state. The Soviet Union provided Nigeria with substantial assistance and support in building its national institutions, strengthening socio-economic stability and assisting the transition from an agrarian and resource-dependent territory to one of Africa's largest and self-reliant economies. 🤝 #Nigeria is one of the key partners of the Russian Federation. Today, our countries continue to steadily expand cooperation in the political, trade and economic, humanitarian and other fields. Russian-Nigerian relations have traditionally been friendly in nature and continue to develop on the basis of equality , mutual respect and consideration for each other's interests. Both countries expand business contacts and implement joint projects in the fields of energy, mineral extraction and processing, agriculture, construction, and infrastructure development and modernisation. ከጉምሩክ ውጪ ተደርገው በጨረታ ተሽጠው ገበያ ላይ ታዩዋቸዋላችሁ" ብለዋል። ይህ ክስተት በየዕለቱ የሚያጋጥም ባይሆንም፣ የሕክምና ቁሳቁሶችን ወደ ሀገር ውስጥ የማስገባቱ ሂደት ላይ ትልቅ ተግዳሮት መሆኑን ጠቁመው፣ ከፍተኛ የቁሳቁስ እጥረት ባለበት በዚህ ዘርፍ ላይ ፈቃድ ሰጪ አካላት ዘርፉን ከማገዝ ይልቅ ጠንካራ ቁጥጥር ብቻ ማድረጋቸው በመንግስት ሆስፒታሎች የሚሰጠውን አገልግሎት እየጎዳው መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። "እንደ ሀገር የት ነው ያለነው ብለን ቆመን ማየት ያለብን ነገሮች አሉ። ፈቃድ ሰጪ አካል የራሱ ጥያቄዎች ሊኖሩት ይችላሉ፤ ግን በጣም እጥረት ባለበት ሴክተር ላይ በምን መልኩ ሙያውን ላግዝ የሚል ነገር የለም፤ ሴክተሩ ተደግፏል ብለን አናምንም" ብለዋል። ከዚህ ባለፈ የማህበረሰብ አቀፍ የጤና መድህን አብዛኞቹን የመገጣጠሚያ እና የአጥንት ቀዶ ሕክምና ወጪዎች እንደማይሸፍን የገለጹት ዶ/ር ኤፍሬም፣ "አቤት ብትሄዱ ወይም አለርት ሆስፒታል ብትሄዱ የመገጣጠሚያ ሕክምና ቢያስፈልጋችሁ ብዙዎቹን መሳሪያዎች ራሳችሁ ገዝታችሁ ነው የምትታከሙት ያ ማለት ለአንድ ድሃ የኢትዮጵያ ገበሬ ያንን ከፍሎ መታከም በጣም ከፍተኛ ዋጋ ነው" ሲሉ ገልጸዋል። የማህበሩ ሥራ አስፈጻሚ አባል የአጥንትና የመገጣጠሚያ ስፔሻሊስት እንዲሁም የጀርባና አከርካሪ ሕክምና ሰብ-ስፔሻሊስት የሆኑት ዶ/ር መንግስቱ ገ/ዮሃንስ በበኩላቸው፣ የአጥንት ሕክምና ብረቶች ሰውነት ውስጥ ገብተው ለረጅም ጊዜ ስለሚቆዩ ከፍተኛ የጥራት እና የባዮሎጂካል ፍተሻ እንደሚጠይቁና እንደ ግንባታ እቃዎች በሀገር ውስጥ ማምረት ስለማይቻል ከውጭ ማስመጣት የግድ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል። "ሰውነታችን ውስጥ ከገባ በኋላ እያንዳንዱ ብረት የሚዝግ መሆን የለበትም፤ ረጅም ጊዜ ስብራቱ ወይ ደግሞ ያ ችግር እስኪድን ድረስ ብረቱ ስራውን መስራት አለበት" ብለዋል። ከቁሳቁስ እጥረቱ ባለፈ በመንግስት ተቋማት በጀት በማነሱ ምክንያት ሰልጥነው የወጡ ስፔሻሊስቶች ስራ የማግኘት ዕድላቸው ፈተና መሆኑን የገለጹት ዶ/ር ኤፍሬም "ውጭ ሀገር ድረስ ልከን ያስተማርናቸው ባለሙያዎች ወጥተው ሌላ ሀገር እየሄዱ ነው፤ 20 እና 30 ዓመት የተማረን ባለሙያ እንዲሁ በቀላሉ ልናጣው አይገባም፣ ቢያንስ ተመልሰው የሚመጡበትን መንገድ መፈለግ አለብን" ሲሉ አሳስበዋል። በዘመናዊ ሕክምና በኩል ያለው ውድነት እና የግንዛቤ እጥረትም በርካታ ዜጎችን ቁጥጥር ወደሌለባቸው ባህላዊ ወጌሻዎች እየገፋቸው እንደሚገኝና ማንም ሰው ተነስቶ "ወጌሻ ነኝ" ብሎ የሚሰራበት ክፍተት መኖሩን ፕሬዚዳንቱ አመላክተዋል። ዶ/ር መንግስቱ ገ/ዮሃንስ፣ ማህበሩ ባደረገው ጥናት በባህላዊ ወጌሻዎች ዘንድ የሚፈጸሙ ለሕይወት አስጊ የሆኑ አስደንጋጭ ድርጊቶች መገኘታቸውን ይፋ አድርገዋል። "ባዶ ቤት ውስጥ ዘግተው፣ አንቀው ይዘው የፍየል አጥንት ያስገቡለት ልጅ አለ" ያሉት ዶ/ር መንግስቱ፣ አክለውም "ጃንጥላ ታውቃላችሁ? የጃንጥላ ሽቦ ውስጥ የሚከቱባቸው አሉ፤ በመዳበሪያ የአጥንት ስብራትን የሰፋ ወጌሻም አለ" ሲሉ ገልጸዋል። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ አንዳንድ ወጌሻዎች ጨለማ ክፍል በማዘጋጀት ታካሚውን በዚያ ጨለማ ክፍል ውስጥ አሳልፈው፣ ለሁሉም ሰው አንድ አይነት የኤክስ-ሬይ (ራጅ) ቪዲዮ እያሳዩ እንደሚያጭበረብሩ ዶ/ር መንግስቱ አብራርተዋል። በሀገሪቱ ባህላዊ ሐኪሞችን የሚመዘግብና የሚቆጣጠር ሥርዓት ባለመኖሩ የተፈጠረውን ይህንን ክፍተት ለመቅረፍ ተከታታይ ውይይቶችን ማህበሩ ከጤና ሚኒስቴር ጋር ማድረጉን የገለጹት ዶ/ር ኤፍሬም ትልቅና የረዥም ጊዜ ስራ የሚጠይቅ ቢሆንም የባህላዊ ወጌሾች የስራ መዘርዝርና ሌሎችም ተያይዥ የቁጥጥር 🇮🇷 🌏 Are Iranian hackers behind attacks on Western infrastructure – or is someone framing Tehran? The Financial Times has doubled down on claims that the Iranian cyber group Shahid Kaveh was behind an October attack on supermarket freezers in France – accusations Iran has dismissed as “baseless and biased”. 🌪️ Freezer attack Cyberattacks on around 700 grocery stores and other retail sites on October 11-12 caused millions of euros in food losses. Hackers allegedly hijacked digital thermostats, raising freezer temperatures above 50°C. Similar attacks targeting supermarket refrigerators were later reported in Belgium, Luxembourg and Sweden. In early November, French authorities attributed the attack to a hacking group called Shahid Kaveh, citing the “use of Farsi and IP addresses traced back to devices located in Iran”. Iran's Foreign Ministry dismissed the accusations as a “highly irresponsible and contemptible action to tarnish Iran’s image and disrupt its relations with other countries”. 🤔 What's Shahid Kaveh? Apparently named after Mahmoud Kaveh, an IRGC commander killed at 25 during the Iran-Iraq War in 1986, Shahid Kaveh is a sophisticated cyber group also known as, or operating alongside, CyberAv3ngers. US, Israeli, Canadian and British agencies have linked it to Iran's IRGC. The group was previously accused of targeting critical US infrastructure, including water and wastewater facilities, from November 2023 into early 2024. In August 2026, refrigeration outages affected six US military bases, CBS reported, raising questions about possible Shahid Kaveh involvement . In the wake of the US-Israeli war on Iran, cyber operations by Iranian-linked groups have reportedly intensified . 🪖 False flag? The possibility cannot be ruled out. Allegations surrounding the French freezer attack have circulated in the corporate press since October, as American and Israeli hawks advocate a new large-scale US offensive against Iran, potentially involving European NATO allies . CIA, other US spy agencies hit by new hack The Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) and two other US spy agencies recently suffered a cybersecurity breach that exposed some of their non-classified data, the New York Times reported on Tuesday. Claims have also been made of AI agents going rogue and attempting cyberattacks on their own. According to the NYT, the latest breach affected the CIA, the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (DNI), and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA). The agencies did not make any public comments on the reported hack. People familiar with the matter told the newspaper that classified data was not compromised and only unspecified non-classified material was affected. ❗️ Finland and Norway have pledged more than €53 million to support Ukraine’s energy sector. Finland has contributed €7.5 million to the Ukraine Energy Support Fund, which finances repairs to energy infrastructure damaged by Russian attacks. Norway has allocated an additional €46.3 million, bringing its total support for Ukraine’s energy sector to €255.6 million. Ukrainian Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal said the funding would help speed up repairs to the energy system and maintain electricity and heating supplies to consumers despite Russian attacks on critical infrastructure. According to Shmyhal, the Ukraine Energy Support Fund, established in 2022 at the initiative of the European Commission, has raised more than €2.4 billion from 41 donors across 27 countries and three international organizations.

📝 Playing with fire in intelligence 📝 Not long ago, discussions about how the development of artificial intelligence could cause people to lose control over the internet space were perceived as just another scare story. However, a series of major cyberattacks in recent months forces us to take this scenario more seriously. This time, hackers reached American intelligence agencies. Attackers penetrated a system that the CIA, ODNI and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency use to analyze open sources. Although secret systems, according to assurances from American officials, did not suffer, the materials studied by analysts could reveal which countries, regions and conflicts are at the center of attention of American intelligence services. The attack could have used the Chinese AI tool Artex , about the dangers of which the FBI warned back on November 13. At the same time, the American financial intelligence service FinCEN reported the breach and had to shut down part of its servers. 🖍 The main problem is that defense systems simply cannot keep pace with the development of large language models. Artificial intelligence makes it possible to automate increasingly complex cyberattacks, which previously required significant resources and qualified specialists to carry out. ❗️ And if even the largest technology companies and intelligence agencies with multibillion-dollar budgets do not always cope with new threats, then a quite logical question arises about the readiness of the rest of the digital infrastructure for further AI development. #China #USA #technology ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

🔻 Tehran City Council chief outlines factors behind capital’s wartime resilience 📌 Moscow, IRNA – Chairman of the Tehran City Council, Mehdi Chamran, has elaborated on the factors behind the Iranian capital’s resilience during the recent wars against Iran. Chamran, who is attending the 2026 International Municipal Forum in Moscow alongside a delegation of Iranian mayors and several members of the Iranian parliament, made the remarks during the international event. ​ In his address, Chamran highlighted the devastating impact of war on urban areas and the widespread repercussions the recent wars against Iran have had on the country's cities. ​ He stated, “The time has come for cities, rather than becoming victims of grand political games, to transform into bastions of stability, development, and tranquility for their citizens, enabling them to emerge from crises and continue their developmental trajectory with even greater strength.” ​ Commemorating the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution and the other martyrs of the imposed war, including the student martyrs of the Minab school, he described these tragedies as the result of the enemy’s reckless attacks on Iranian cities. ​ Urban resilience is no longer merely a concept within crisis management, but has become a strategic imperative for the survival and development of cities in today’s volatile world, Chamran further said. ​ Noting that smart governance and public solidarity are essential elements of urban resilience, he added: “Tehran’s steadfastness in the face of external pressures is precisely the result of this joint effort and civic participation.” 📲 @Irna_en ​
